prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kuzunoha, benevolent white fox spirit whose human disguise is revealed.
ANATOMY: ONE dignified adult Japanese woman in a fully opaque layered plain ivory and brown robe, one head, TWO human eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs; ONE LONG WHITE FOX TAIL visibly emerges from behind her robe [kuzunoha-c04,kuzunoha-c05,kuzunoha-c08]. Human face fully human, no fox ears, extra tails or hybrid muzzle. Tail clearly living fur, broad and unmistakably attached at lower back.
MOMENT: Turn sharply away from chrysanthemums toward viewer at moment white fox tail slips fully out behind robe, one hand sweeps robe aside unintentionally exposing the tail, other reaches toward viewer in poignant farewell. Noble intense protective face, grief and resolve rather than evil or flirtation. Hair and sleeve sweep with the turn. No child needed.
POWER: Human form revealed by glimpse of tail beside chrysanthemums [kuzunoha-c05]; returning to wild Shinoda forest [kuzunoha-c08]. No invented spell particles or glowing fox magic.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low close three-quarter body with white tail curving large across foreground beside robe, face and tail both clear; ordinary human scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant cold moon or amber sunset, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, physical rain or dust appropriate to scene.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin, coarse opaque cloth, wet hair, wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Chrysanthemums at edge of Shinoda forest [kuzunoha-c05,kuzunoha-c08].
MOOD: imposing active encounter, never cute, calm or decorative. Preserve benevolent figures as dignified and noble, not evil.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Kuzunoha, benevolent white fox spirit whose human disguise is revealed

visual_requirements.description: Fox adopts woman form, white fox identity
White tail reveals identity while human
Turning farewell at revealed guise, no magical effect

aura: Documented anatomy and active encounter create imposing presence, no generic aura.
artistic_choices: Human-disguise with one exposed tail distinguishes from ordinary woman or ordinary fox; no fox ears or multiple tails invented. Noble sorrow and sweeping farewell, not evil spirit.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one human woman face/two eyes/two arms and natural hands, opaque layered robe, ONE clearly furry white fox tail emerging beneath robe at lower back and sweeping foreground. Turning farewell reach amid chrysanthemums and Shinoda forest, noble intense sorrow rather than evil. Human/fox revelation distinctive at200; no added fox ears or aura/text. All Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, reaching-hand, robe-gripping-hand, tail and torii crops. One adult woman (kuzunoha-c04/c08) with a fully human face (one head, two eyes, no fox ears or muzzle) in a fully opaque layered ivory-and-brown kimono with a sash. ONE huge, unmistakable white fox tail of real wet fur sweeps out from under her robe at the lower back across the whole foreground as one hand pulls the robe aside. This is the glimpse of the tail that reveals her true nature (c05), and she is the white fox (c08); there are no extra tails. Her other hand reaches out toward the viewer in farewell, with the thumb and three fingers visible and the fourth foreshortened (natural, not malformed). She turns from wet white and yellow chrysanthemums (c05) at the edge of a moonlit, rainy cedar forest, with a plain shrine torii (no plaque or text) and steps behind her (Shinoda forest and shrine, c06/c08). Her noble, sorrowful resolve fits a benevolent kami, not an evil or flirtatious one. The extreme low angle and the giant tail make the revelation legible and arresting at 200px. No spell effects, aura, text or borrowed design.
